string-array.name: month_quotes
string-array.item: "January: A fresh start is simply the next quiet breath you choose to take."
"February: Small acts of kindness, including toward yourself, add up."
"March: Growth is slow, and that is still growth."
"April: Let something new bloom at its own pace."
"May: Rest is productive. Give yourself room to recover."
"June: Step outside, slow down, and notice one good thing."
"July: You are allowed to take up space and take your time."
"August: Progress, not perfection, is the goal worth keeping."
"September: Begin again. Every day is a reasonable place to start."
"October: Change can be gentle. Let it be."
"November: Gratitude turns what you have into enough."
"December: Be as patient with yourself as you are with others."

string-array.name: motivational_quotes
string-array.item: "You have already survived every hard day up to now."
"Small steps, taken daily, still carry you forward."
"You do not have to do it all at once. Just the next thing."
"Progress counts even when it is quiet."
"Your effort matters more than being perfect."
"Rest is part of the work, not a break from it."
"You are allowed to begin again, as many times as you need."
"Showing up today is enough."

string-array.name: encouragement_quotes
string-array.item: "Be as kind to yourself as you would be to a good friend."
"It is okay to take up space and ask for what you need."
"Whatever you are feeling is allowed to be here."
"You are doing better than your worries tell you."
"One breath at a time is a perfectly good pace."
"You are worthy of rest, care, and good things."
"Give yourself credit for how far you have come."
"You are not behind. You are on your own path."

string-array.name: app_updates
string-array.item: "New: Dashboard now shows today's date and a quote for the month."
"New: In-app guide added - tap the guide button to learn the basics."
"Improved: Smoother navigation between pages."
